references.text: The same amount of flour (one-tenth of an ephah) is prescribed for each lamb in the daily burnt offering
An identical prescription of one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour per lamb for the new moon offerings at the beginning of the month
The same amount of flour per lamb is prescribed for the Feast of Unleavened Bread
A corresponding regulation for the grain offering at the Festival of Weeks (Pentecost)
The same grain offering amount per lamb is prescribed for the day of the Feast of Trumpets
An identical prescription for the offerings on the Day of Atonement with the fourteen lambs
The Feast of Tabernacles with its seven days plus the eighth day of solemn assembly, which is the context for these offering regulations
